explicit_limits: This profile owns lowercase .kt Kotlin/JVM sources compiled directly with kotlinc for JVM 17. It does not imply Kotlin/JS, Kotlin/Native, Android, Multiplatform, KAPT, KSP, compiler plugins, Gradle plugins, Maven plugins, or dependency resolution.

The profile intentionally does not claim .kts. Source inventory keeps Kotlin scripts visible as unsupported; the Kotlin provider recognizes only exact Gradle script names as configuration context and never treats scripts as compilable project sources.

A build.gradle.kts or settings.gradle.kts marker indicates possible project metadata, not a usable Gradle build. The dependency-free proof never invokes Gradle and makes no Kotlin-plugin compatibility claim.

Compiler exit status and diagnostics prove only that the exact source manifest compiles in the observed configuration. The shipped compiler internals and experimental backend dumps are not a stable semantic API, so project-wide symbol, call, override, data-flow, reflection, generated-code, and alternate-variant facts remain unavailable.
